name: Draconic Tail (Combat)
body:
You grow a dragon’s tail while fighting.

Prerequisite(s): Access to natural claw attacks, bloodrager or sorcerer with the draconic bloodline, base attack bonus +5, Draconic Manifestation.

Benefit(s): Whenever you manifest your claws, you also gain a tail slap attack. This is a secondary attack dealing 1d6 points of damage (1d4 if you are Small), plus 1—½ times your Strength modifier.
